subject: general
question: What was the theme of the second edition of the Defence Literature Festival 'Kalam & Kavach 2.0'?

options.text: Securing India’s Rise through Defence Reforms

solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Securing India’s Rise through Defence Reforms**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Centre for Joint Warfare Studies Hosts Defence Literature Festival ‘Kalam & Kavach 2.0’ in New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **second edition of the Defence Literature Festival**, **‘Kalam & Kavach 2.0’**, was hosted by **CENJOWS** in collaboration with **Pentagon Press**.

 
 
• 
 
The event was held at the **Manekshaw Centre** in **New Delhi** on **April 15, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
This year’s theme was **‘Securing India’s Rise through Defence Reforms’**.

 
 
• 
 
The focus of the event was on **Defence Technology and Future Warfare**, especially in **defence manufacturing**.

 
 
• 
 
**Raksha Mantri Rajnath Singh** declared **2025 as the ‘Year of Reforms’**, aiming to make the **Armed Forces technologically advanced and combat-ready**.
